title: FFmpeg Probe Inventory
problem: Nako's hardware capability report can represent stage facts, but the detector still derives most evidence from ffmpeg encoder discovery.

evidence.summary: Opened the FFmpeg probe inventory lane and accepted ADR 0046 for structured stage-aware probe ownership.
Added FfmpegProbeInventory and parser coverage for encoders, decoders, hwaccels, filters, and bitstream filters.
Mapped probe inventory facts into required and optional hardware stage capabilities.
Updated FFmpeg detector execution to run all required inventory probes and degrade safely on probe failure.
Updated Admin diagnostics, verified focused gates, and closed the lane with follow-ons documented in HANDOFF.md.

continue_policy.notes: This lane is closed. Open a follow-on for filter-option probing, CPU codec readiness, QSV/VideoToolbox decoder command tightening, or Admin Web diagnostics wiring.
